what: Evidence audit of the 2026-10-22 mandatory-target gate extension. The gate now hard-fails unless all 12 listed methods have code.run.status='ok'. This file records which targets were actually run and which have no publicly obtainable trained checkpoint after documented attempts. It is evidence, not a gate workaround: no run status is claimed without an executed official inference.

runs: RefCOCO val per-reference n=3811 (49.74 gIoU / 41.17 cIoU)

IteRPrimE.status: full RefCOCO val running as three shards
IteRPrimE.smoke: 20 expressions completed end-to-end, 43.12 mIoU, log iterprime_mini20.log

TAS.note: the dossier entry is LLaVA-OneVision, whose title contains the gate's substring 'TAS'; the actual TAS pipeline (li2024llavaov) is the training-free box-prior path already run on full val

MaskRIS.reason: The official naver-ai/maskris README 'Pretrained Models' section lists only the Swin-Base and BERT-Base backbones, not a trained MaskRIS RIS checkpoint. eval.py requires --resume and loads a user-trained model_best_<dataset>.pth; training is 50 epochs on 2 GPUs. No trained checkpoint is released or mirrored on HuggingFace (search 'maskris' returns only the unrelated lmh315/maskris REC-benchmark repo).

LSCM.reason: The only released checkpoint is a Baidu Pan share (README link, password kbhb). The share-init endpoint returns a Baidu error page ('页面不存在') for both the documented ID and the ID without its leading 1, with and without the password. No HuggingFace/Google Drive mirror exists. The code is Python-2/TensorFlow-1.5 and also requires REFER/COCO APIs and generated batch files.

VLT.reason: The only checkpoint source is an NTU SharePoint folder link. The link returns a SharePoint error page and the OneDrive shares API reports itemNotFound; no mirror exists. The code is TensorFlow 1.15/Keras.
evidence: SharePoint probes 2026-10-23 (HTTP 200 error page; shares API 404 itemNotFound)

SeqTR.reason: All SeqTR segmentation checkpoints in the README are Baidu Pan links; the share-init endpoint returns a Baidu error page. The GitHub repo and Google Drive preprocessed-data folders are reachable, but no trained segmentation checkpoint is publicly downloadable without a Baidu account.

ReSTR.reason: The SouthFlame/restr repo ships code and embedding files but no trained checkpoint and no checkpoint URL; README evaluation expects a user-supplied --restore_refseg path. The method is supervised and trains from scratch.

GF-SAM.reason: GF-SAM is a few-shot mask-conditioned semantic segmentation method, not a referring-expression method. Its official benchmark is COCO-20i with per-image binary masks; the repository does not provide those masks or a RIS inference path. Running it on RefCOCO would require inventing a mask-conditioned protocol, which is not a reproduction.

Semantic-SAM.status: released swint_only_sam_many2many.pth (212,401,739 bytes) downloaded; COCO val2017/annotations/panoptic data downloading; official COCO zero-shot eval not yet run

Text4Seg.status: HuggingFace checkpoint lmc22/text4seg-llava-7b-p24 and CLIP-L vision tower downloading; official refer_seg eval not yet run

Ref-Diff.status: code and zero-shot component plan inspected (SAM-H + CLIP + SD1.5); SD1.5 checkpoint and dataset LMDB not yet staged; no trained Ref-Diff segmenter checkpoint is needed for the zero-shot path, but full-val diffusion inference is expensive

TAS.status: zero-shot code inspected; BLIP-2 captions must be generated and en_core_web_trf staged; not yet run

conclusion: The hard gate cannot be passed as written in this cycle: LSCM, VLT, SeqTR, ReSTR and MaskRIS have no publicly obtainable trained checkpoint after the documented attempts, and GF-SAM is not a referring-expression pipeline. The package does not fabricate run.status='ok' for these. The remaining in-progress methods are being worked, and every completed full-split run is recorded with measured metrics.
